name: Idaho Precision Machines
old_description: Idaho Precision Machining & Fabrication, Inc. manufactures aftermarket performance accessories for Motorcycles, ATV/UTV, Snowmobile parts along with machining a wide range of food service parts. We pride ourselves on supplying quality American-made products, at an affordable price.
about:
Idaho Precision Machining & Fabrication, Inc. operates from Eagle, Idaho. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business focuses on aftermarket performance accessories and precision machining for powersports and food-service markets.

The shop produces aftermarket performance accessories for motorcycles, ATV/UTV, and snowmobiles, including custom machined parts, Harley-Davidson components, snowmobile parts, UTV custom parts, and boat/fishing accessories. It also machines a range of food-service components. Capabilities include machining and fabrication, though specific equipment and facility size are not published.

Customers span the powersports aftermarket — motorcycle, ATV/UTV, and snowmobile enthusiasts — as well as marine and food-service sectors. The company sells directly through its website, offering items such as UTV roof consoles and custom machined components.

The company states that it differentiates itself by supplying quality American-made products at an affordable price.
